title: SwngPro™ Train the Swing. Win the Match.
description: The SwngPro™ is a magnetic tennis swing trainer that tells you, on every swing, whether your mechanics were right. Calibrated magnets create progressive resistance: when your grip, swing path and timing line up, the core releases with an audible snap. When they don't, it stays silent. You always know which swing to repeat. Train your forehand, backhand, serve and volley at home, in the garage or at the club, with no court, ball or partner needed. Ten minutes a day is a few hundred checked reps, which is how a consistent swing gets built into muscle memory. Five resistance levels, adjusted with a simple dial (11–33 N), from first swing to advanced Real racket grip (1:1 shape and feel) so the swing you build at home transfers to the court Shorter than a standard racket for safe full swings indoors No batteries, no app, no assembly Includes the 15-Day Swing Mastery Program: step-by-step daily drills (10–15 minutes) from fundamentals to full-speed match simulation Designed for recreational tennis players of any level, from beginners learning clean contact to club players working on consistency and power. What's in the box: SwngPro™ trainer, 15-Day Swing Mastery Program (digital access), quick-start drill card, carry bag.
